comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py. The crates below publish no license text on crates.io; their texts are copied verbatim from the upstream repositories into licenses/rust/ (provenance in licenses/README.md). Versions are pinned where the text comes from a release commit or tag, so an upgrade fails the generator until the text is checked again.

crates.name: alloc-stdlib
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; BSD-3-Clause per Cargo.toml. LICENSE copied from github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib at 0a81fd6, the commit the 0.3.0 crate was published from (.cargo_vcs_info.json)

crates.name: dlopen2
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml. LICENSE copied from github.com/OpenByteDev/dlopen2 at cc80e4a, the commit the 0.8.2 crate was published from; Linux only

crates.name: ndb-oui
crates.note: Contains MAC OUI vendor data (data/oui.bin, built from resources/oui.csv in github.com/shellrow/ndb) derived from the IEEE Registration Authority's OUI assignments. Upstream does not document how the table was compiled.
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml. LICENSE copied from github.com/shellrow/ndb at bb29a49, the commit the 0.4.1 crate was published from. The crate compiles a vendor table into the binary, so the note records where the data comes from (finding Lantenna-m3)

crates.name: siphasher
crates.reason: The crate's COPYING only points to LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE, which 1.0.2 does not publish. Texts copied from github.com/jedisct1/rust-siphash at tag 1.0.4, the first tag that has them; COPYING ships too and carries the copyright lines

crates.name: objc2*
crates.reason: The objc2 crates (macOS only) publish no license file. objc2, objc2-foundation and objc2-encode are MIT, the others Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT (LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2); MIT chosen for all. LICENSE-MIT.txt copied from that repository, which added it in ee9a7ad (March 2026) for every crate in it

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT); macOS only

crates.name: dispatch2
crates.reason: Same repository as objc2; Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, MIT chosen; macOS only
